title: Mask of Tutankhamun
official_description: A golden funerary mask made for the burial of the young pharaoh Tutankhamun around 1323 BCE.
historical_context: Placed over the face of the mummified pharaoh and rediscovered in his tomb in 1922.
visual_description: A gleaming gold face with a striped blue and gold headdress, dark lined eyes, and a braided false beard, with a vulture and cobra on the brow.

chunks.text: The Mask of Tutankhamun is a golden funerary mask made around 1323 BCE for the burial of the young Egyptian pharaoh Tutankhamun.
The mask shows a calm gold face framed by a striped blue and gold headdress, with lined eyes and a braided false beard.
Discovered in the pharaoh's tomb in 1922, the mask was placed directly over the mummy's face and reflects beliefs about protection in the afterlife.
Le masque de Toutankhamon est un masque funeraire en or realise vers 1323 av. J.-C. pour l'inhumation du jeune pharaon egyptien Toutankhamon.
Le masque montre un visage d'or calme encadre par une coiffe rayee bleue et or, avec des yeux soulignes et une fausse barbe tressee.
